  original_receivables:=smarter_private.original_erased_cash_receivables(p_union_id,p_at);
  IF original_receivables->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'ready' THEN
   issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_unproven','evidence',original_receivables));
  ELSE
   IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(holdings) existing JOIN jsonb_array_elements(original_receivables->'holdings') owed
    ON existing->>'source_id'=owed->>'source_id') THEN
    issues:=issues||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','original_erased_receivable_double_count_refused'));
   ELSE holdings:=holdings||(original_receivables->'holdings');END IF;
  END IF;
 END IF;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('status',CASE WHEN issues='[]'::jsonb THEN 'ready' ELSE 'blocked' END,'boundary',p_at,
  'inventory',inv,'holdings',holdings,'issues',issues,'tournament_basis','original_realized_settlement_deferred_while_open');
END $function$

signature: smarter_private.union_pnl_original_flow_evidence_window(uuid,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION smarter_private.union_pnl_original_flow_evidence_window(p_union_id uuid, p_start timestamp with time zone, p_end timestamp with time zone, p_window_start timestamp with time zone, p_window_end timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_id uuid, club_id uuid, user_id uuid, buyins numeric, cashouts numeric, kind text, valid boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
 WITH originals AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,q.ledger_snapshot l,(q.game_scope->>'tournament_id')::uuid tournament_id
  FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q WHERE q.game_scope->>'game_union_id'=p_union_id::text
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_start AND q.recognized_at<p_end
   AND q.recognized_at>=p_window_start AND q.recognized_at<p_window_end
 ), rf_original_keys AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT q.transaction_id,(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid table_id,
   (q.l->>'club_id')::uuid club_id,(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid user_id,(q.l->>'amount')::numeric amount
  FROM originals q
  WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
   AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
 ), rf_original_matches AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount,count(*) refunds,
   min(o.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(o.user_id::text)::uuid player
  FROM rf_original_keys k
  JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.transaction_id=k.transaction_id
   AND a.refunded>0 AND a.refunded=k.amount
  JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts o ON o.id=a.funding_receipt_id
  WHERE a.pending_addon_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o.pending_addon_id AND a.original_occupancy_id=o.occupancy_id
   AND o.table_id=k.table_id AND o.account_type='player_wallet' AND o.account_entity_id=k.user_id
   AND o.funding_club_id=k.club_id AND o.user_id=k.user_id
  GROUP BY k.transaction_id,k.table_id,k.club_id,k.user_id,k.amount
 ), matched AS (
  SELECT q.*,f.id cash_funding_id,f.funding_club_id cash_club,f.user_id cash_user,f.amount cash_amount,
   e.id entry_id,e.funding_club_id entry_club,e.user_id entry_user,e.amount entry_amount,
   c.ledger_id credit_id,c.credited_club_id credit_club,c.user_id credit_user,c.amount credit_amount,
   ret.owners,ret.funding_club_id return_club,ret.user_id return_user,mv.moved_club,mv.moved_user,
   COALESCE(rf.refunds,0) refunds,rf.club refund_club,rf.player refund_user,te.refund_ent,te.refund_ent_user,te.refund_ent_club,late.n late_count,late.club late_club,late.player late_user,late.delta late_delta
  FROM originals q
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(*) n,min(p.club_id::text)::uuid club,min(p.user_id::text)::uuid player,min(p.delta) delta
   FROM (SELECT q.ledger_id WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL
    AND q.l->>'category'='settlement' AND q.l->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%' OFFSET 0) eligible
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(eligible.ledger_id) p
  ) late ON true
  -- One-time filter (20261001): a probe only for the flows that can match.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT f.* FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND f.source_ledger_id=q.ledger_id OFFSET 0) f ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT e.* FROM public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts e
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND e.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND e.asset='chips' AND q.tournament_id=e.tournament_id OFFSET 0) e ON true
  -- fn_union_pnl_tournament_returns(q.tournament_id,NULL,p_start,p_end) for
  -- this flow's ledger only: its two branches verbatim, keyed by the ledger.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT c.ledger_id,c.tournament_id,c.user_id,c.credited_club_id,c.amount
   FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=c.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND c.ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND c.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
   UNION ALL
   SELECT t.credit_ledger_id,t.tournament_id,t.user_id,t.source_wallet_club_id,t.amount_paid_now
   FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches t
   JOIN public.tournament_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.entitlement_id=t.entitlement_id
   JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames b ON b.transaction_id=t.transaction_id
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND b.observed_at>=p_start AND b.observed_at<p_end
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_accounting_credit_receipts c2 WHERE c2.ledger_id=t.credit_ledger_id)
  ) c ON true
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT count(DISTINCT (r.funding_club_id,r.user_id)) owners,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid funding_club_id,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid user_id
   FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r
   WHERE r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid AND r.operation_kind='buyin'
    AND q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND r.account_type=q.l->>'to_type' AND r.account_entity_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.funding_club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid
    AND (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i WHERE i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats'
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'occupancy_id'=r.occupancy_id::text
      AND COALESCE(i.after_row,i.before_row)->>'table_id'=r.table_id::text)
     OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_funding_application_receipts a JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts original ON original.id=a.funding_receipt_id
       WHERE a.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND original.occupancy_id=r.occupancy_id AND a.refunded=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric))
  ) ret ON true
  -- A seat cashed out after it arrived by a table move holds chips whose
  -- original buy-in is on the source occupancy, not this one. The occupancy
  -- the cash-out vacated (its seat row in the same original transaction,
  -- carrying exactly the cashed-out stack) is traced through its move receipts
  -- by fn_cash_original_funding_lineage, the proof the boundaries and hands
  -- already use; the owner is its one original buy-in's club and player.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.club END moved_club,
    CASE WHEN lin.v->'issues'='[]'::jsonb AND jsonb_array_length(lin.v->'moves')>0 AND own.receipts>0 AND own.buyins=1
     AND own.clubs=1 AND own.users=1 AND own.club::text=q.l->>'club_id' AND own.player::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id'
     THEN own.player END moved_user
   FROM (SELECT min(i.before_row::text)::jsonb seat,count(*) n FROM public.union_pnl_inventory_events i
     WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet'
      AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
      AND i.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND i.source_name='table_seats' AND i.before_row->>'table_id'=q.l->>'table_id'
      AND i.before_row->>'user_id'=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND i.before_row->'left_at'='null'::jsonb
      AND i.after_row->>'left_at' IS NOT NULL) s
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((s.seat->>'user_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'table_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'id')::uuid,
     (s.seat->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,(s.seat->>'joined_at')::timestamptz,q.recognized_at,false) v) lin
   CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) receipts,count(*) FILTER(WHERE r.operation_kind='buyin') buyins,count(DISTINCT r.funding_club_id) clubs,
     count(DISTINCT r.user_id) users,min(r.funding_club_id::text)::uuid club,min(r.user_id::text)::uuid player
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin.v->'funding_receipts') ref JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts r ON r.id=(ref->>'id')::uuid) own
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND ret.owners IS DISTINCT FROM 1
    AND s.n=1 AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(s.seat->'stack') IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) mv ON true
  -- A pending add-on returned unapplied is a refund of this player's own
  -- escrowed chips. Its wallet credit can carry no refund category: it runs
  -- inside the hand's post-commit obligations, after atomic_distribute_rake
  -- has declared that transaction's ledger context, so the audit labels it
  -- player_funding under the rake settlement. The application receipt
  -- written in the same transaction proves it: exactly one refund of this
  -- amount from a funding receipt of this player, club and table.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT r.refunds,r.club,r.player FROM rf_original_matches r
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NULL AND q.l->>'from_type'='table_stack'
    AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='player_funding'
    AND r.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND r.table_id=(q.l->>'table_id')::uuid
    AND r.club_id=(q.l->>'club_id')::uuid AND r.user_id=(q.l->>'to_entity_id')::uuid
    AND r.amount=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
  ) rf ON true
  -- A seat won in a satellite and later refunded by the target tournament
  -- (cancelled, or the seat released) pays the seat's value back to the
  -- player's wallet from the target's prize liability. That seat was never a
  -- wallet-funded entry of the target, so no tournament credit receipt exists
  -- for it; its proof is the refund entitlement the payout is keyed by: same
  -- tournament, player, wallet club and gross, and the seat's owning club as
  -- resolved from its satellite registration.
  LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
   SELECT t.id refund_ent,t.user_id refund_ent_user,t.refund_wallet_club_id refund_ent_club
   FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements t
   WHERE q.tournament_id IS NOT NULL AND t.tournament_id=q.tournament_id
    AND q.l->>'idempotency_key'='tourney:'||t.tournament_id::text||':refund-entitlement:'||t.id::text
    AND t.entitlement_kind IN('satellite_seat','wallet_charge','tournament_ticket') AND t.gross=(q.l->>'amount')::numeric
    AND t.user_id::text=q.l->>'to_entity_id' AND t.refund_wallet_club_id::text=q.l->>'club_id'
    AND q.l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND q.l->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND q.l->>'category'='refund'
    AND CASE t.entitlement_kind
     WHEN 'satellite_seat' THEN public.fn_union_pnl_satellite_seat_owner(t.registration_id,NULL)=t.refund_wallet_club_id
     -- A pre-capture wallet entry refunded by cancellation (20261006154000):
     -- its entitlement's source ledger is the entry proven at the opening
     -- boundary of the refund's own week, for this exact registration, club
     -- and gross.
     WHEN 'wallet_charge' THEN t.source_ledger_id IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.union_pnl_opening_registration_resolutions r
       WHERE r.boundary=public.fn_union_week_start(q.recognized_at) AND r.union_id=p_union_id AND r.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND r.user_id=t.user_id
        AND r.owning_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id AND r.entries=1 AND r.entry_amount=t.gross AND r.returned=0
        AND r.proof_md5=md5(r.proof::text)
        AND r.proof->'entry_ledger' @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('ledger_id',t.source_ledger_id::text)))=1
     WHEN 'tournament_ticket' THEN t.charge_category='tournament_ticket'
      AND t.evidence_kind='atomic_tournament_ticket' AND t.escrow_bucket='ticket_gross'
      AND q.l->>'from_entity_id'=t.tournament_id::text
      AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.tournament_tickets replacement WHERE replacement.source_refund_entitlement_id=t.id)
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_entitlements duplicate WHERE duplicate.source_ticket_id=t.source_ticket_id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr
       WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id AND tr.credit_ledger_id=q.ledger_id AND tr.transaction_id=q.transaction_id
        AND tr.tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tr.user_id=t.user_id AND tr.source_wallet_club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tr.idempotency_key=q.l->>'idempotency_key' AND tr.amount_paid_before=0 AND tr.amount_paid_now=t.gross
        AND tr.refund_prize=t.refund_prize AND tr.refund_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tr.refund_fee=t.refund_fee)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_refund_tranches tr WHERE tr.entitlement_id=t.id)=1
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.tournament_tickets tk
       JOIN public.chip_ledger admission ON admission.id=t.source_ledger_id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_awards a ON a.ticket_id=tk.id
       JOIN public.tournament_satellite_settlements h ON h.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
       JOIN public.tournament_payouts p ON p.id=a.payout_id
       JOIN public.chip_ledger issue ON issue.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key||':ticket_escrow'
       WHERE tk.id=t.source_ticket_id AND tk.holder_id=t.user_id AND tk.club_id=t.refund_wallet_club_id
        AND tk.status='redeemed' AND tk.redemption_mode='tournament_entry_only' AND tk.cancelled_at IS NULL
        AND tk.value=t.gross AND tk.entry_prize=t.refund_prize AND tk.entry_bounty=t.refund_bounty AND tk.entry_fee=t.refund_fee
        AND t.gross=t.refund_prize+t.refund_bounty+t.refund_fee
        AND tk.source_tournament_id=t.tournament_id AND tk.source_satellite_id=t.source_satellite_id
        -- Only the original direct award is admitted here. A replacement
        -- ticket still requires its distinct original refund disposition.
        AND tk.source_refund_entitlement_id IS NULL
        AND a.tournament_id=tk.source_satellite_id AND a.place=tk.source_satellite_award_place
        AND a.user_id=t.user_id AND a.delivery_kind='ticket' AND a.amount=t.gross AND a.payout_source='satellite_ticket'
        AND p.tournament_id=a.tournament_id AND p.user_id=a.user_id AND p.amount=a.amount
        AND p.source=a.payout_source AND p.idempotency_key=a.idempotency_key
        AND (p.position=a.place OR h.receipt_version>=3)
        AND h.target_id=t.tournament_id AND h.ticket_cost=t.gross
        AND h.target_buy_in=tk.entry_prize+tk.entry_bounty AND h.target_fee=tk.entry_fee
        AND issue.status='posted' AND issue.category='ticket_issue' AND issue.amount=t.gross
        AND issue.club_id=tk.club_id AND issue.tournament_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.from_type='prize_liability' AND issue.from_entity_id=a.tournament_id
        AND issue.to_type='escrow' AND issue.to_entity_id=tk.id
        AND issue.metadata->>'kind'='direct_satellite_entry_ticket'
        AND issue.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND issue.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND issue.metadata->>'satellite_target_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND COALESCE(issue.metadata->>'position',issue.metadata->>'award_slot')=a.place::text
        AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.wallet_credit_idempotency w WHERE w.key=a.idempotency_key)
        AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.chip_transactions x
          WHERE x.transaction_type='tournament_ticket_issue' AND x.club_id=tk.club_id
           AND x.from_user_id IS NULL AND x.to_user_id=t.user_id AND x.amount=t.gross
           AND x.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND x.metadata->>'ledger_id'=issue.id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'payout_id'=p.id::text AND x.metadata->>'idempotency_key'=a.idempotency_key
           AND x.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=a.tournament_id::text
           AND x.metadata->>'source_award_place'=a.place::text)=1
        AND admission.status='posted' AND admission.category='ticket_redeem' AND admission.amount=t.gross
        AND admission.club_id=tk.club_id AND admission.tournament_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.from_type='escrow' AND admission.from_entity_id=tk.id
        AND admission.to_type='prize_liability' AND admission.to_entity_id=t.tournament_id
        AND admission.idempotency_key='ticket:'||tk.id::text||':tournament:'||t.tournament_id::text||':entry'
        AND admission.metadata->>'kind'='tournament_entry_ticket_admission'
        AND admission.metadata->>'ticket_id'=tk.id::text AND admission.metadata->>'user_id'=t.user_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'registration_id'=t.registration_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_tournament_id'=t.tournament_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->>'source_satellite_id'=t.source_satellite_id::text
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_prize'=to_jsonb(t.refund_prize)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_bounty'=to_jsonb(t.refund_bounty)
        AND admission.metadata->'entry_fee'=to_jsonb(t.refund_fee))=1
     ELSE false END
  ) te ON true
 ), projected AS (
  SELECT *,CASE WHEN late_count=1 THEN 'cash_late_settlement' WHEN cash_funding_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cash_funding' WHEN owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR refunds=1 THEN 'cash_return'
    WHEN entry_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_funding' WHEN credit_id IS NOT NULL OR refund_ent IS NOT NULL THEN 'tournament_return' ELSE 'unsupported' END k,
   COALESCE(late_club,cash_club,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_club WHEN owners=1 THEN return_club ELSE refund_club END,entry_club,credit_club,refund_ent_club) owner_club,
   COALESCE(late_user,cash_user,CASE WHEN moved_club IS NOT NULL THEN moved_user WHEN owners=1 THEN return_user ELSE refund_user END,entry_user,credit_user,refund_ent_user) owner_user
  FROM matched
 ) SELECT ledger_id,owner_club,owner_user,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta<0 THEN -late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_funding','tournament_funding') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,
  CASE WHEN k='cash_late_settlement' AND late_delta>0 THEN late_delta WHEN k IN('cash_return','tournament_return') THEN (l->>'amount')::numeric ELSE 0 END,k,
  (l->>'status'='posted' AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(l->'amount')>0 AND owner_club IS NOT NULL AND owner_user IS NOT NULL
   AND owner_club::text=l->>'club_id' AND game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND CASE k
    WHEN 'cash_late_settlement' THEN late_count=1 AND abs(late_delta)=(l->>'amount')::numeric
    WHEN 'cash_funding' THEN cash_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND l->>'category' IN('buyin','rebuy','addon','horse_funding')
    WHEN 'cash_return' THEN (owners=1 OR moved_club IS NOT NULL OR (refunds=1 AND l->>'category'='player_funding')) AND l->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND (l->>'category' IN('cashout','table_cashout','refund')
     OR (l->>'category'='player_funding' AND refunds=1 AND refund_club=owner_club AND refund_user=owner_user))
    WHEN 'tournament_funding' THEN entry_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric AND l->>'to_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_buyin','rebuy','addon')
    WHEN 'tournament_return' THEN (credit_amount=(l->>'amount')::numeric OR (credit_id IS NULL AND refund_ent IS NOT NULL)) AND l->>'from_type'='prize_liability' AND l->>'category' IN('tournament_prize','prize','bounty','refund','tournament_refund')
    ELSE false END) IS TRUE
 FROM projected
;
$function$

signature: ca_player_stats_hand_evidence(uuid,uuid,text,text,text,numeric,timestamp with time zone,timestamp with time zone,text,boolean,boolean,boolean,boolean,text,boolean,text,uuid,timestamp with time zone,uuid,integer)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ca_player_stats_hand_evidence(p_user uuid, p_club_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_asset text DEFAULT 'chips'::text, p_variant text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_position text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_big_blind numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_from timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_to timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_outcome text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_showdown boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_all_in boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_big_pots boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_noted boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_hand_class text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_tournament boolean DEFAULT NULL::boolean, p_cash_metric text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_cash_session_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_cursor_played_at timestamp with time zone DEFAULT NULL::timestamp with time zone, p_cursor_hand_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limit integer DEFAULT 25)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_session public.cash_player_session%ROWTYPE;
  v_session_asset text;
  v_overlap integer;
  v_limit integer := least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit,25),1),100);
  v_cash_metric text := lower(nullif(btrim(p_cash_metric),''));
BEGIN
  -- funded_stats_scope: historical funding, original caller gates.
  PERFORM public.ca_assert_self(p_user);
  IF p_asset IS NULL OR p_asset NOT IN ('chips','diamonds') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown stats asset: %',p_asset USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_cash_session_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN public.ca_player_stats_hand_evidence_base(
      p_user,p_club_id,p_asset,p_variant,p_position,p_big_blind,p_from,p_to,
      p_outcome,p_showdown,p_all_in,p_big_pots,p_noted,p_hand_class,p_tournament,
      v_cash_metric,p_cursor_played_at,p_cursor_hand_id,p_limit);
  END IF;
  IF (p_cursor_played_at IS NULL) <> (p_cursor_hand_id IS NULL) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'session evidence cursor requires played_at and hand_id together'
      USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF v_cash_metric IS NOT NULL AND v_cash_metric NOT IN (
    'three_bet','four_bet','steal','squeeze','blind_defense','cbet_flop',
    'barrel_turn','barrel_river','check_raise','donk','probe'
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unknown cash evidence metric: %',p_cash_metric USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  SELECT s.* INTO v_session
    FROM public.cash_player_session s
    JOIN public.clubs c ON c.id=s.club_id
    JOIN public.club_members m ON m.club_id=c.id AND m.user_id=p_user
   WHERE s.id=p_cash_session_id AND s.player_id=p_user
     AND m.status IN ('active','approved')
     AND coalesce(c.lifecycle_status,'active')<>'retired'
     AND coalesce(c.asset,'chips')=p_asset
     AND (p_club_id IS NULL OR s.club_id=p_club_id);
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'cash session evidence refused' USING ERRCODE='42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(c.asset,'chips') INTO v_session_asset
    FROM public.clubs c WHERE c.id=v_session.club_id;
  SELECT count(*)::integer INTO v_overlap
    FROM public.cash_player_session o
   WHERE o.player_id=p_user AND o.id<>v_session.id
     AND o.club_id=v_session.club_id
     AND ((v_session.cluster_id IS NOT NULL AND o.cluster_id=v_session.cluster_id)
          OR (v_session.cluster_id IS NULL AND o.cluster_id IS NULL
              AND o.table_id=v_session.table_id))
     AND tstzrange(o.opened_at,coalesce(o.closed_at,'infinity'),'[)') &&
         tstzrange(v_session.opened_at,coalesce(v_session.closed_at,'infinity'),'[)');
  IF v_overlap>0 THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract_version',3,'hands','[]'::jsonb,'has_more',false,
      'next_cursor',NULL,'evidence_status','overlap_unavailable',
      'scope',jsonb_build_object('target_user_id',p_user,'cash_session_id',v_session.id,
        'club_id',v_session.club_id,'asset',v_session_asset,'visibility','owner'),'generated_at',now());
  END IF;

  RETURN (WITH filtered AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.hand_id,f.played_at,f.funded_club AS club_id,f.table_id,f.net,f.net_bb,f.game_variant,
      v_cash_metric cash_metric,
      CASE v_cash_metric
        WHEN 'three_bet' THEN f.three_bet WHEN 'four_bet' THEN f.four_bet
        WHEN 'steal' THEN f.stole WHEN 'squeeze' THEN f.squeezed
        WHEN 'blind_defense' THEN f.defended_blind WHEN 'cbet_flop' THEN f.cbet_flop
        WHEN 'barrel_turn' THEN f.barreled_turn WHEN 'barrel_river' THEN f.barreled_river
        WHEN 'check_raise' THEN f.check_raised WHEN 'donk' THEN f.donk_bet
        WHEN 'probe' THEN f.probe_bet ELSE NULL END cash_metric_action
      FROM (
 WITH receipts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON(table_id,account_entity_id,seat_joined_at)
   table_id,account_entity_id,seat_joined_at,funding_club_id
  FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts
  WHERE account_entity_id=p_user AND operation_kind='buyin'
  ORDER BY table_id,account_entity_id,seat_joined_at,recorded_at DESC,id DESC
 ), funding AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT *,lead(seat_joined_at) OVER(PARTITION BY table_id,account_entity_id ORDER BY seat_joined_at) until_at
  FROM receipts
 )
 SELECT fact.*,coalesce(x.funding_club_id,tp.club_id,ra.club_id,fact.club_id) funded_club
 FROM public.ca_hand_facts fact
 LEFT JOIN funding x ON fact.tournament_id IS NULL AND x.table_id=fact.table_id
  AND fact.played_at>=x.seat_joined_at AND (x.until_at IS NULL OR fact.played_at<x.until_at)
 LEFT JOIN public.tournament_players tp ON tp.tournament_id=fact.tournament_id AND tp.user_id=fact.user_id
 LEFT JOIN public.rake_attributions ra ON x.funding_club_id IS NULL AND tp.club_id IS NULL
  AND ra.hand_id=fact.hand_id AND ra.player_id=fact.user_id
 WHERE fact.user_id=p_user
 ) f LEFT JOIN public.tables t ON t.id=f.table_id
     WHERE f.user_id=p_user AND f.funded_club=v_session.club_id AND f.tournament_id IS NULL
       AND f.played_at>=v_session.opened_at
       AND f.played_at<coalesce(v_session.closed_at,'infinity')
       AND ((v_session.cluster_id IS NOT NULL AND t.cluster_id=v_session.cluster_id)
            OR (v_session.cluster_id IS NULL AND f.table_id=v_session.table_id))
       AND (v_cash_metric IS NULL OR CASE v_cash_metric
          WHEN 'three_bet' THEN f.three_bet_opportunity
          WHEN 'four_bet' THEN f.four_bet_opportunity
          WHEN 'steal' THEN f.steal_opportunity
          WHEN 'squeeze' THEN f.squeeze_opportunity
          WHEN 'blind_defense' THEN f.blind_defense_opportunity
          WHEN 'cbet_flop' THEN f.cbet_flop_opportunity
          WHEN 'barrel_turn' THEN f.barrel_turn_opportunity
          WHEN 'barrel_river' THEN f.barrel_river_opportunity
          WHEN 'check_raise' THEN f.check_raise_opportunity
          WHEN 'donk' THEN f.donk_opportunity
          WHEN 'probe' THEN f.probe_opportunity ELSE false END IS TRUE)
       AND (p_cursor_played_at IS NULL OR
         (f.played_at,f.hand_id)<(p_cursor_played_at,p_cursor_hand_id))
     ORDER BY f.played_at DESC,f.hand_id DESC LIMIT v_limit+1
  ), page AS (SELECT * FROM filtered ORDER BY played_at DESC,hand_id DESC LIMIT v_limit),
  last_row AS (SELECT played_at,hand_id FROM page ORDER BY played_at,hand_id LIMIT 1)
  SELECT jsonb_build_object('contract_version',3,
    'hands',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY played_at DESC,hand_id DESC) FROM page p),'[]'::jsonb),
    'has_more',(SELECT count(*)>v_limit FROM filtered),
    'next_cursor',CASE WHEN (SELECT count(*)>v_limit FROM filtered) THEN
      (SELECT jsonb_build_object('played_at',played_at,'hand_id',hand_id) FROM last_row) ELSE NULL END,
    'evidence_status','exact_session','scope',jsonb_build_object('target_user_id',p_user,
      'cash_session_id',v_session.id,'club_id',v_session.club_id,'asset',v_session_asset,
      'cash_metric',v_cash_metric,'visibility','owner'),'generated_at',now()));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_prove_original_unchanged_stack(p_table_id uuid, p_hand_number bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 o public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes%ROWTYPE; p public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts%ROWTYPE;
 m public.cash_hand_participant_manifests%ROWTYPE; x jsonb; hp jsonb; r record;
 v_issue_users uuid[]; v_user uuid; v_occ uuid; v_seat uuid; v_join timestamptz; v_before numeric; v_after numeric;
 prev_hn bigint; prev_at timestamptz; prev_after numeric; nxt_hn bigint; nxt_at timestamptz; nxt_before numeric;
 v_ids uuid[]; v_amts numeric[]; v_kinds text[]; v_split integer; v_prefix numeric; v_late numeric; v_late_total numeric;
 v_extra numeric; v_matched boolean; v_people jsonb; v_result jsonb; prev_receipt public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
 IF p_table_id IS NULL OR p_hand_number IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_outcome_identity' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 BEGIN
 -- CORE BEGIN (the dry run executes exactly this text)
 v_result:=NULL; v_people:='[]'; v_issue_users:=ARRAY[]::uuid[]; v_late_total:=0;
 SELECT * INTO o FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes WHERE table_id=p_table_id AND hand_number=p_hand_number;
 IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:outcome_missing'; END IF;
 IF o.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'blocked' OR o.evidence ? 'reason'
  OR o.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR o.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope
  OR o.evidence->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id::text
  OR jsonb_typeof(o.evidence->'issues') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(o.evidence->'participants') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:outcome_not_a_blocked_complete_population'; END IF;
 -- Every other defect keeps the hand blocked: only the unproven starting stack is resolvable.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'issues') e(v)
   WHERE NOT (e.v='"original_cash_funding_incomplete"'::jsonb
    OR (jsonb_typeof(e.v)='object' AND e.v->>'reason'='original_seat_or_starting_stack_unproven' AND (e.v->>'user_id') IS NOT NULL)))
  OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'issues') e(v) WHERE e.v='"original_cash_funding_incomplete"'::jsonb)<>1 THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:outcome_has_other_evidence_defects'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'participants') e(v)
   WHERE e.v->'ownership_certified' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR (e.v->>'earning_club_id') IS NULL) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:earning_ownership_not_certified'; END IF;
 SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT (e.v->>'user_id')::uuid) INTO v_issue_users FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'issues') e(v) WHERE jsonb_typeof(e.v)='object';
 IF COALESCE(cardinality(v_issue_users),0)=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:no_unproven_stack'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO p FROM public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts WHERE table_id=p_table_id AND hand_number=p_hand_number;
 IF NOT FOUND OR p.hand_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id OR p.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM o.payload_hash
  OR p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'uncertified' OR p.funding_provenance_complete IS DISTINCT FROM false
  OR p.all_players_included IS DISTINCT FROM true THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:provenance_identity_mismatch'; END IF;
 SELECT * INTO m FROM public.cash_hand_participant_manifests WHERE id=p.manifest_id;
 IF NOT FOUND OR m.table_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id OR m.hand_number IS DISTINCT FROM p_hand_number
  OR m.captured_at IS NULL OR m.issues IS DISTINCT FROM p.issues OR jsonb_typeof(m.issues) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:manifest_identity_mismatch'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.issues) e(v) WHERE e.v->>'reason' IS DISTINCT FROM 'original_seat_or_starting_stack_unproven')
  OR (SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT (e.v->>'user_id')::uuid ORDER BY (e.v->>'user_id')::uuid) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.issues) e(v))
     IS DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(u ORDER BY u) FROM unnest(v_issue_users) u) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:manifest_defects_are_not_only_the_starting_stack'; END IF;
 -- The complete original signed population still decides this hand's money.
 -- Proving one retired chair never forgives another participant's defect.
 IF p.game_scope IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope OR m.game_scope IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope
  OR o.game_scope->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR o.game_scope->'unit_scale' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'::jsonb
  OR o.game_scope->'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR NOT o.game_scope ?& ARRAY['host_club_id','game_union_id','asset','unit_scale','is_private','tournament_id']
  OR o.game_scope->>'host_club_id' IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(o.game_scope->'is_private') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
  OR (o.game_scope->'is_private'='false'::jsonb AND o.game_scope->>'game_union_id' IS NULL)
  OR p.accepted_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p.accepted_at) OR p.accepted_at<m.captured_at OR NOT isfinite(m.captured_at)
  OR p.accepted_request->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id::text
  OR p.accepted_request->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_hand_number::text
  OR NOT public.fn_cash_signed_retained_request_matches(p_table_id,p_hand_number,p.payload_hash,p.accepted_request)
  OR p.atomic_receipt->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id::text
  OR p.atomic_receipt->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_hand_number::text
  OR p.atomic_receipt->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id::text
  OR p.atomic_receipt->>'payload_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM o.payload_hash
  OR p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->'success' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'delta'
  OR p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->'conservation_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR coalesce((p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,request,rake}')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.rake
  OR coalesce((p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,request,bbj}')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.bbj
  OR coalesce((p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,request,inflow}')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.signed_external_net
  OR p.stack_claim->>'hand_id' IS NULL
  OR p.stack_claim->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded'
  OR p.stack_claim->'result' IS DISTINCT FROM p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'
  OR p.stack_settlement->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final'
  OR p.stack_claim->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->>'hand_id'
  OR p.stack_settlement->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.stack_claim->>'hand_id'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p.accepted_request->'stacks') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(p.participants) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_typeof(m.participants) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants)<2 OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants)>10
  OR jsonb_array_length(m.participants)<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants)
  OR jsonb_array_length(o.evidence->'participants')<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.accepted_request->'stacks')<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}')<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants)
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT z.v->>'user_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants)z(v))<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:original_signed_population_unproven'; END IF;
 FOR r IN SELECT z.v part FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants)z(v) LOOP
  IF r.part->>'stack_before' IS NULL OR r.part->>'stack_after' IS NULL
   OR (r.part->>'stack_before')::numeric<0 OR (r.part->>'stack_after')::numeric<0
   OR r.part->>'stack_before' IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR r.part->>'stack_after' IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:invalid_original_stack'; END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.participants)q(v)
       WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=r.part->>'user_id' AND q.v->>'occupancy_id'=r.part->>'occupancy_id'
        AND q.v->>'seat_id'=r.part->>'seat_id'
        AND (q.v->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=(r.part->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz
        AND (q.v->>'stack_before')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_before')::numeric
        AND q.v->'funding_lineage'=r.part->'funding_lineage')<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.accepted_request->'stacks')q(v)
       WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=r.part->>'user_id' AND q.v->>'occupancy_id'=r.part->>'occupancy_id'
        AND q.v->>'seat_id'=r.part->>'seat_id'
        AND (q.v->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=(r.part->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz
        AND (q.v->>'stack_before')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_before')::numeric
        AND (q.v->>'stack')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_after')::numeric)<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}')q(v)
       WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=r.part->>'user_id' AND q.v->>'seat_id'=r.part->>'seat_id'
        AND (q.v->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=(r.part->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz
        AND (q.v->>'stack_before')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_before')::numeric
        AND (q.v->>'stack')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_after')::numeric)<>1
   OR public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((r.part->>'user_id')::uuid,p_table_id,(r.part->>'seat_id')::uuid,(r.part->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,
       (r.part->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz,(r.part#>>'{funding_lineage,observed_at}')::timestamptz,false) IS DISTINCT FROM r.part->'funding_lineage'
   OR r.part#>'{funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.part#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}')ref(v))=0
   OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT (f.funding_club_id,f.funding_union_id,f.asset)) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.part#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}')ref(v) JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=(ref.v->>'id')::uuid)<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.part#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}')ref(v) JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=(ref.v->>'id')::uuid WHERE f.operation_kind='buyin')<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'participants')q(v)
       WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=r.part->>'user_id' AND q.v->'ownership_certified'='true'::jsonb
        AND q.v->>'ownership_scope'='original_chip_funding_club'
        AND q.v->>'earning_club_id'=(SELECT min(f.funding_club_id::text) FROM jsonb_array_elements(r.part#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}')ref(v) JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=(ref.v->>'id')::uuid)
        AND (q.v->>'observed_stack_delta')::numeric=(r.part->>'stack_after')::numeric-(r.part->>'stack_before')::numeric)<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:original_player_or_delta_disagrees'; END IF;
 END LOOP;
 IF p.signed_external_net IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR p.rake IS NULL OR p.bbj IS NULL OR p.rake<0 OR p.bbj<0
  OR (o.evidence->>'accepted_rake')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM p.rake
  OR (SELECT sum((z.v->>'stack_after')::numeric-(z.v->>'stack_before')::numeric) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants)z(v))+p.rake+p.bbj IS DISTINCT FROM p.signed_external_net
  OR coalesce((p.accepted_request->>'rake')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.rake
  OR coalesce((p.accepted_request->>'bbj')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.bbj
  OR coalesce((p.accepted_request->>'inflow')::numeric,0) IS DISTINCT FROM p.signed_external_net THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:original_conservation_disagrees'; END IF;
 FOREACH v_user IN ARRAY v_issue_users LOOP
  SELECT e.v INTO x FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.participants) e(v) WHERE e.v->>'user_id'=v_user::text;
  SELECT e.v INTO hp FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants) e(v) WHERE e.v->>'user_id'=v_user::text;
  v_occ:=(x->>'occupancy_id')::uuid; v_seat:=(x->>'seat_id')::uuid; v_join:=(x->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz;
  v_before:=(x->>'stack_before')::numeric; v_after:=(hp->>'stack_after')::numeric;
  IF x IS NULL OR hp IS NULL OR v_occ IS NULL OR v_seat IS NULL OR v_join IS NULL OR v_before IS NULL OR v_after IS NULL
   OR hp->>'occupancy_id' IS DISTINCT FROM v_occ::text OR (hp->>'stack_before')::numeric IS DISTINCT FROM v_before THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:participant_identity_missing'; END IF;
  -- The seat generation is the one its own funding receipts were recorded
  -- against (each receipt is written from the live seat row); the table_seats
  -- row itself is not retained after the player leaves.
  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f WHERE f.occupancy_id=v_occ)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f WHERE f.occupancy_id=v_occ
    AND (f.seat_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_seat OR f.seat_joined_at IS DISTINCT FROM v_join
     OR f.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_user OR f.table_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:seat_identity_unproven'; END IF;
  -- The stack this occupancy carried out of its previous accepted hand.
  prev_hn:=NULL; prev_at:=NULL; prev_after:=0;
  SELECT pr.hand_number,pr.accepted_at,(pp.v->>'stack_after')::numeric INTO prev_hn,prev_at,prev_after
   FROM public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts pr CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(pr.participants) pp(v)
   WHERE pr.table_id=p_table_id AND pr.hand_number<p_hand_number AND pp.v->>'occupancy_id'=v_occ::text
   ORDER BY pr.hand_number DESC LIMIT 1;
  IF prev_hn IS NULL THEN prev_after:=0;
  ELSE
   IF prev_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(prev_at) OR prev_at>m.captured_at OR prev_after IS NULL OR prev_after<0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:previous_hand_unusable'; END IF;
   IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes po WHERE po.table_id=p_table_id AND po.hand_number=prev_hn
     AND po.evidence->'all_players_included' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb AND po.evidence->'game_scope' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM po.game_scope
     AND ((po.evidence->>'status' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'ready' AND po.evidence->'basis_certified' IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb)
      OR /*R*/EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcome_resolutions rr WHERE rr.table_id=po.table_id AND rr.hand_number=po.hand_number
       AND rr.hand_id=po.hand_id AND rr.outcome_payload_hash=po.payload_hash AND rr.outcome_evidence_md5=md5(po.evidence::text))/*R*/)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:previous_hand_not_accepted'; END IF;
  END IF;
  -- This is a separate proof class. A real late credit still uses its own
  -- existing nonempty suffix proof. No zero-valued synthetic receipt exists.
  IF prev_hn IS NULL OR prev_after IS DISTINCT FROM v_before THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:no_equal_accepted_predecessor'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO STRICT prev_receipt FROM public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts
   WHERE table_id=p_table_id AND hand_number=prev_hn;
  IF prev_receipt.game_scope IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id::text
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM prev_hn::text
   OR prev_receipt.accepted_request->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table_id::text
   OR prev_receipt.accepted_request->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM prev_hn::text
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes po WHERE po.table_id=p_table_id AND po.hand_number=prev_hn
      AND po.hand_id=prev_receipt.hand_id AND po.payload_hash=prev_receipt.payload_hash AND po.game_scope=prev_receipt.game_scope)
   OR NOT public.fn_cash_signed_retained_request_matches(p_table_id,prev_hn,prev_receipt.payload_hash,prev_receipt.accepted_request)
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM prev_receipt.hand_id::text
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->>'payload_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM prev_receipt.payload_hash
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->'success' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->'conservation_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'->>'mode' IS DISTINCT FROM 'delta'
   OR prev_receipt.stack_claim->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded'
   OR prev_receipt.stack_claim->'result' IS DISTINCT FROM prev_receipt.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'
   OR prev_receipt.stack_settlement->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final'
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(prev_receipt.accepted_request->'stacks') s(v)
       WHERE s.v->>'user_id'=v_user::text AND s.v->>'occupancy_id'=v_occ::text AND s.v->>'seat_id'=v_seat::text
        AND (s.v->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=v_join AND (s.v->>'stack')::numeric=v_before)<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(prev_receipt.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}') s(v)
       WHERE s.v->>'user_id'=v_user::text AND s.v->>'seat_id'=v_seat::text
        AND (s.v->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz=v_join
        AND (s.v->>'stack')::numeric=v_before)<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:predecessor_signed_stack_unproven'; END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f
    WHERE f.occupancy_id=v_occ AND f.recorded_at>prev_at AND f.recorded_at<=m.captured_at)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f JOIN public.cash_funding_application_receipts a ON a.funding_receipt_id=f.id
    WHERE f.occupancy_id=v_occ AND a.applied>0 AND a.applied_at>prev_at AND a.applied_at<=m.captured_at)
   OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.cash_seat_move_receipts mv
    WHERE (mv.source_occupancy_id=v_occ OR mv.destination_occupancy_id=v_occ)
      AND mv.created_at>prev_at AND mv.created_at<=m.captured_at) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:intervening_original_input'; END IF;
  -- Reprove the affected occupancy's original funding owner at its captured
  -- lineage instant. This reader never uses current club memberships.
  IF public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage(v_user,p_table_id,v_seat,v_occ,v_join,
      (x#>>'{funding_lineage,observed_at}')::timestamptz,false) IS DISTINCT FROM x->'funding_lineage'
   OR x#>'{funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'unchanged_stack_refused:original_funding_lineage_disagrees'; END IF;
  v_people:=v_people||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('user_id',v_user,'occupancy_id',v_occ,
   'seat_id',v_seat,'seat_joined_at',v_join,'dealt_stack_before',v_before,'stack_after',v_after,
   'previous_hand',jsonb_build_object('hand_number',prev_hn,'hand_id',prev_receipt.hand_id,
     'payload_hash',prev_receipt.payload_hash,'accepted_at',prev_at,'stack_after',prev_after),
   'intervening_funding_receipts',0,'current_membership_used',false));
 END LOOP;
 v_result:=jsonb_build_object('status','proven','resolution_kind','original_stack_unchanged_since_accepted_predecessor',
  'table_id',p_table_id,'hand_number',p_hand_number,'hand_id',o.hand_id,'outcome_payload_hash',o.payload_hash,
  'outcome_evidence_md5',md5(o.evidence::text),'manifest_id',m.id,'manifest_captured_at',m.captured_at,
  'late_total',0,'participants',v_people,'current_seats_used',false,'current_membership_used',false);
 EXCEPTION
  WHEN raise_exception THEN
   IF SQLERRM LIKE 'unchanged\_stack\_refused:%' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','refused','reason',substr(SQLERRM,25),'table_id',p_table_id,'hand_number',p_hand_number);
   END IF;
   RAISE;
  WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR datetime_field_overflow OR invalid_datetime_format THEN
   RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','refused','reason','malformed_original_evidence','table_id',p_table_id,'hand_number',p_hand_number);
 END;
 RETURN v_result;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_prove_late_settlement(p_ledger_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(club_id uuid, user_id uuid, delta numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 RETURN QUERY
 WITH original AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.* FROM public.union_pnl_original_flows q
  JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=q.ledger_id AND to_jsonb(l)=q.ledger_snapshot
  JOIN public.union_pnl_transaction_frames frame ON frame.transaction_id=q.transaction_id AND frame.observed_at=q.recognized_at
  WHERE q.ledger_id=p_ledger_id AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'status'='posted'
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'category'='settlement' AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'row_hash' IS NOT NULL
   AND q.game_scope ?& ARRAY['host_club_id','game_union_id','asset','unit_scale','is_private','tournament_id']
   AND jsonb_typeof(q.game_scope->'is_private')='boolean'
   AND q.game_scope->'tournament_id'='null'::jsonb
   AND q.game_scope->>'asset'='chips' AND q.game_scope->'unit_scale'='2'::jsonb
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key' LIKE 'late_seat_settle:%'
 ), linked AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT q.*,s.id settlement_id,s.hand_id legacy_id,s.totals,
   a.*,o.evidence,o.game_scope outcome_scope,
   live.hand_id live_hand_id,live.payload_hash live_payload_hash,live.stack_result live_stack_result,
   live.post_commit_completed_at live_completed_at,live.post_commit_result live_postcommit,
   cert.history_hand_id retained_hand_id,cert.manifest_id retained_manifest,cert.settled_at retained_completed_at,cert.hand_number retained_number,
   cert.original_result_sha256 retained_result_sha,cert.original_request_sha256 retained_stack_request_sha,cert.accounting_evidence_sha256 retained_evidence_sha,
   v.accepted_request,v.participants original_participants,v.stack_claim,v.stack_settlement,v.manifest_id original_manifest,v.accepted_at original_accepted_at,
   smarter_private.horse_settlement_original_result(k.table_id,k.hand_id,k.result) claim_result,k.status claim_status
  FROM original q
  JOIN public.ca_settlements s ON s.id=(q.ledger_snapshot->>'settlement_id')::uuid
   AND s.table_id=(q.ledger_snapshot->>'table_id')::uuid
   AND s.settlement_type='hand_stacks' AND s.state='final' AND s.tournament_id IS NULL
  JOIN public.settlement_idempotency_keys k ON k.table_id=s.table_id AND k.hand_id=s.hand_id
  JOIN public.cash_hand_provenance_receipts v ON v.table_id=s.table_id AND v.hand_number=(k.result->>'hand_number')::bigint
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.hand_atomic_commits,v.atomic_receipt) a
  LEFT JOIN public.hand_atomic_commits live ON live.table_id=a.table_id AND live.hand_number=a.hand_number
  LEFT JOIN smarter_private.horse_settlement_key_certificates cert ON cert.table_id=s.table_id AND cert.stack_hand_id=s.hand_id
  JOIN public.union_pnl_cash_outcomes o ON o.table_id=a.table_id AND o.hand_number=a.hand_number
   AND o.hand_id=a.hand_id AND o.payload_hash=a.payload_hash AND public.fn_union_pnl_cash_outcome_accepted(o)
  WHERE q.game_scope=o.game_scope AND v.game_scope=o.game_scope
   AND v.hand_id=a.hand_id AND v.payload_hash=a.payload_hash AND v.table_id=a.table_id AND v.hand_number=a.hand_number
   AND s.hand_id=md5('ca-hand:'||s.table_id::text||':'||a.hand_number::text||
    CASE WHEN s.totals->>'ref' IS NULL OR s.totals->>'ref'='' THEN '' ELSE ':'||(s.totals->>'ref') END)::uuid
   AND q.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key'='late_seat_settle:'||s.hand_id::text||':'||
    CASE WHEN q.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' THEN q.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'
      ELSE q.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id' END
 ), witnessed AS (
  SELECT a.*,d.v departed,p.v participant,r.v signed_request,own.v owner,
   public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(d.v->'delta') signed_delta,
   public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(a.ledger_snapshot->'amount') amount
  FROM linked a
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.stack_result->'departed') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=CASE WHEN a.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' THEN a.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id' ELSE a.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id' END) d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.original_participants) x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.accepted_request->'stacks') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') r
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT x v FROM jsonb_array_elements(a.evidence->'participants') x
   WHERE x->>'user_id'=d.v->>'user_id') own
 )
 SELECT (w.departed->>'club_id')::uuid,(w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid,w.signed_delta
 FROM witnessed w
 JOIN public.wallet_credit_idempotency credit ON credit.key=w.ledger_snapshot->>'idempotency_key'
  AND credit.user_id=(w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid AND credit.amount=w.signed_delta
 WHERE w.claim_status='succeeded' AND w.claim_result=w.stack_result
  AND w.stack_claim->'result'=w.stack_result AND w.stack_settlement->'totals'=w.totals
  AND w.totals->'departed'=w.stack_result->'departed'
  AND w.stack_result->'success'='true'::jsonb AND w.stack_result->'conservation_checked'='true'::jsonb
  AND w.accepted_request->>'table_id'=w.table_id::text
  AND w.accepted_request->>'hand_number'=w.hand_number::text
  AND public.fn_cash_signed_retained_request_matches(w.table_id,w.hand_number,w.payload_hash,w.accepted_request)
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.stack_result#>'{request,stacks}') refs(v)
   WHERE refs.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id' AND refs.v->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
    AND refs.v->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
    AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(refs.v->'stack')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')
    AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(refs.v->'stack_before')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before'))=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.stack_result->'departed') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.accepted_request->'stacks') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.evidence->'participants') q(v) WHERE q.v->>'user_id'=w.departed->>'user_id')=1
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids'))=
      (SELECT count(DISTINCT v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(v))
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v)
   WHERE public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_before') IS NULL OR public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_after') IS NULL
    OR public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'poker_delta') IS DISTINCT FROM
       public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_after')-public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'stack_before'))
  AND (SELECT sum(public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(q.v->'poker_delta')) FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.original_participants) q(v))
      +public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'rake')+public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'bbj')
      =public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.accepted_request->'inflow')
  AND CASE WHEN w.live_hand_id IS NOT NULL THEN
   w.live_hand_id=w.hand_id AND w.live_payload_hash=w.payload_hash AND w.live_stack_result=w.stack_result
   AND w.live_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(w.live_completed_at) AND w.live_postcommit->'ok'='true'::jsonb
  ELSE w.retained_hand_id=w.hand_id AND w.retained_manifest=w.original_manifest
   AND w.retained_number=w.hand_number AND w.retained_completed_at IS NOT NULL AND isfinite(w.retained_completed_at)
   AND w.retained_completed_at>=w.original_accepted_at AND w.retained_completed_at>=w.committed_at
   -- These digests name the full retained monetary original in provenance,
   -- never the compact key's JSON or a reconstructed expired raw hand.
   AND w.retained_result_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(w.stack_result::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   AND w.retained_stack_request_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((w.stack_result->'request')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   AND w.retained_evidence_sha=encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((w.evidence-'accepted_bbj'-'accepted_rake'-'accepted_external_net')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') END
  AND w.amount>0 AND w.signed_delta<>0 AND abs(w.signed_delta)=w.amount
  AND public.fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((w.participant->>'user_id')::uuid,w.table_id,
    (w.participant->>'seat_id')::uuid,(w.participant->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,
    (w.participant->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz,(w.participant#>>'{funding_lineage,observed_at}')::timestamptz,false)
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM w.participant->'funding_lineage'
  AND w.participant#>'{funding_lineage,issues}'='[]'::jsonb
  AND (SELECT array_agg(refs.v->>'id' ORDER BY refs.v->>'id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(w.participant#>'{funding_lineage,funding_receipts}') refs(v))
      IS NOT DISTINCT FROM (SELECT array_agg(refs.v ORDER BY refs.v) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(v))
  AND w.participant->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
  AND w.participant->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
  AND w.signed_request->>'seat_id'=w.departed->>'seat_id'
  AND w.signed_request->>'seat_joined_at'=w.departed->>'seat_joined_at'
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before') IS NOT NULL
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after') IS NOT NULL
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')-public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before')=w.signed_delta
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.signed_request->'stack_before')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_before')
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.signed_request->'stack')=public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.participant->'stack_after')
  AND w.owner->'ownership_certified'='true'::jsonb
  AND w.owner->>'earning_club_id'=w.departed->>'club_id'
  AND w.owner->>'earning_club_id'=w.ledger_snapshot->>'club_id'
  AND public.fn_pnl_evidence_cents(w.owner->'observed_stack_delta')=w.signed_delta
  AND jsonb_array_length(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids')>0
  AND (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(receipt_id)
    JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=refs.receipt_id::uuid WHERE f.operation_kind='buyin')=1
  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(w.owner->'funding_receipt_ids') refs(receipt_id)
   LEFT JOIN public.cash_participant_funding_receipts f ON f.id=refs.receipt_id::uuid
   LEFT JOIN public.chip_ledger l ON l.id=f.source_ledger_id
   WHERE f.id IS NULL OR f.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM (w.departed->>'user_id')::uuid
    OR f.funding_club_id IS DISTINCT FROM (w.departed->>'club_id')::uuid
    OR f.funding_union_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM w.game_scope->>'game_union_id'
    OR f.account_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet' OR f.account_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.user_id
    OR f.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR f.unit_scale IS DISTINCT FROM 2
    OR f.amount<=0 OR f.amount IS NULL OR f.amount<>round(f.amount,2) OR f.amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    OR f.balance_before-f.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount
    OR l.id IS NULL OR l.row_hash IS NULL OR l.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'posted' OR l.amount IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount
    OR l.club_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.funding_club_id OR l.from_type IS DISTINCT FROM f.account_type
    OR l.from_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.user_id OR l.to_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'table_stack'
    OR l.to_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.table_id OR l.category IS DISTINCT FROM f.operation_kind)
  AND CASE WHEN w.signed_delta>0 THEN
   w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_type'='table_stack' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id'=w.table_id::text
   AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='player_wallet' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'=w.departed->>'user_id'
  ELSE w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_type'='player_wallet' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'from_entity_id'=w.departed->>'user_id'
   AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_type'='table_stack' AND w.ledger_snapshot->>'to_entity_id'=w.table_id::text END;
EXCEPTION WHEN SQLSTATE '55000' THEN
 IF SQLERRM='HORSE_SETTLEMENT_COMPACT_ORIGINAL_CONFLICT' THEN RETURN;END IF;RAISE;
WHEN invalid_text_representation OR numeric_value_out_of_range OR invalid_parameter_value THEN
 RETURN;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_union_pnl_prove_posthand_escrow(p_table uuid, p_number bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
DECLARE o union_pnl_cash_outcomes; p cash_hand_provenance_receipts; m cash_hand_participant_manifests;
 a hand_atomic_commits; prev cash_hand_provenance_receipts; f cash_participant_funding_receipts; app cash_funding_application_receipts;
 cert smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates; retained boolean; live boolean; completed_at timestamptz; pending_ids jsonb; result jsonb;
 affected uuid; part jsonb; original jsonb; lin jsonb; ref jsonb; owned uuid; refs uuid[]; total numeric:=0;
 before_stack numeric; after_stack numeric; prev_stack numeric; submitted jsonb; proof_people jsonb:='[]'; witness union_pnl_inventory_events;
BEGIN
 SELECT * INTO o FROM union_pnl_cash_outcomes WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 IF NOT FOUND OR o.evidence->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'blocked'
  OR o.evidence->'all_players_included' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR o.evidence->'game_scope' IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope
  OR o.transaction_id IS NULL OR o.recognized_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(o.recognized_at)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM union_pnl_transaction_frames fr WHERE fr.transaction_id=o.transaction_id AND fr.observed_at=o.recognized_at) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:blocked_original_population_required';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT p FROM cash_hand_provenance_receipts WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 SELECT * INTO STRICT m FROM cash_hand_participant_manifests WHERE id=p.manifest_id;
 IF (p.table_id,p.hand_number,p.hand_id,p.payload_hash,p.game_scope) IS DISTINCT FROM (o.table_id,o.hand_number,o.hand_id,o.payload_hash,o.game_scope)
  OR (m.table_id,m.hand_number,m.game_scope) IS DISTINCT FROM (p_table,p_number,o.game_scope)
  OR m.issues IS DISTINCT FROM p.issues OR p.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'uncertified'
  OR p.funding_provenance_complete IS DISTINCT FROM false OR p.all_players_included IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR p.accepted_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(p.accepted_at) OR m.captured_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(m.captured_at) OR m.captured_at>o.recognized_at OR o.recognized_at>p.accepted_at
  OR o.game_scope->>'asset' IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR o.game_scope->'unit_scale' IS DISTINCT FROM '2'::jsonb
  OR o.game_scope->'tournament_id' IS DISTINCT FROM 'null'::jsonb
  OR pg_input_is_valid(o.game_scope->>'host_club_id','uuid') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR pg_input_is_valid(o.game_scope->>'game_union_id','uuid') IS DISTINCT FROM true
  OR jsonb_typeof(o.game_scope->'is_private') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
  OR NOT o.game_scope ?& ARRAY['host_club_id','game_union_id','asset','unit_scale','is_private','tournament_id']
  OR p.accepted_request->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text OR p.accepted_request->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_number::text
  OR NOT public.fn_cash_signed_retained_request_matches(p_table,p_number,p.payload_hash,p.accepted_request) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_identity_or_signature_disagrees';END IF;
 SELECT min((x->>'user_id'))::uuid INTO affected FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.issues) x;
 IF affected IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(m.issues)<>2
  OR NOT m.issues @> jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','pending_funding_application_unproven','user_id',affected),jsonb_build_object('reason','original_cash_move_lineage_unproven','user_id',affected,'details',jsonb_build_array('pending_funding_application_unproven')))
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.issues) x WHERE x->>'user_id' IS DISTINCT FROM affected::text
    OR NOT (x=jsonb_build_object('reason','pending_funding_application_unproven','user_id',affected)
      OR x=jsonb_build_object('reason','original_cash_move_lineage_unproven','user_id',affected,'details',jsonb_build_array('pending_funding_application_unproven'))))
  OR o.evidence->'issues' IS DISTINCT FROM (jsonb_build_array('original_cash_funding_incomplete')||m.issues||
    jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('reason','participant_earning_ownership_receipt_invalid','user_id',affected))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:only_exact_pending_escrow_defects_qualify';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO cert FROM smarter_private.posthand_escrow_certificates WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 retained:=FOUND;
 IF retained AND (cert.hand_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id
  OR cert.original_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(cert.original::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unnest(ARRAY['source_financial_request_sha256','original_accounting_evidence_sha256','qualified_evidence_sha256','original_participant_roster_sha256','immutable_financial_sha256','original_atomic_sha256','compact_atomic_sha256','original_stack_result_sha256','original_stack_request_sha256','postcommit_payload_sha256','postcommit_request_sha256','postcommit_result_sha256']) name WHERE jsonb_typeof(cert.original->name) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string' OR cert.original->>name !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
  OR cert.original->'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb
  OR cert.original->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text OR cert.original->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_number::text
  OR cert.original->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id::text OR cert.original->>'manifest_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.manifest_id::text
  OR (cert.original->>'accepted_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM p.accepted_at
  OR cert.original->>'source_financial_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM p.payload_hash
  OR cert.original->>'original_accounting_evidence_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(o.evidence::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR cert.original->>'original_participant_roster_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.participants::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR cert.original->>'immutable_financial_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((to_jsonb(p)-ARRAY['accepted_request','atomic_receipt','accepted_at'])::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR (encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.atomic_receipt::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original->>'original_atomic_sha256'
   AND encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(p.atomic_receipt::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original->>'compact_atomic_sha256')
  OR cert.original->>'stack_hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,hand_id}'
  OR cert.original->>'original_stack_result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR cert.original->>'original_stack_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to((p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request}')::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
  OR cert.original->>'postcommit_payload_sha256' IS NULL OR cert.original->>'postcommit_payload_sha256' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR cert.original->>'postcommit_request_sha256' IS NULL OR cert.original->>'postcommit_request_sha256' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR cert.original->>'postcommit_result_sha256' IS NULL OR cert.original->>'postcommit_result_sha256' !~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
  OR jsonb_typeof(cert.original->'pending_ids') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(cert.original->'pending_ids')<>1
  OR NOT pg_input_is_valid(cert.original#>>'{pending_ids,0}','uuid')
  OR cert.original->>'committed_at' IS NULL OR cert.original->>'completed_at' IS NULL
  OR NOT isfinite((cert.original->>'committed_at')::timestamptz) OR NOT isfinite((cert.original->>'completed_at')::timestamptz)
  OR (cert.original->>'completed_at')::timestamptz<(cert.original->>'committed_at')::timestamptz) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:immutable_original_postcommit_certificate_disagrees';END IF;
 SELECT * INTO a FROM hand_atomic_commits WHERE table_id=p_table AND hand_number=p_number;
 live:=FOUND;
 IF live THEN
 IF a.hand_id IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id OR a.payload_hash IS DISTINCT FROM o.payload_hash
  OR a.stack_result IS DISTINCT FROM p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'
  OR p.atomic_receipt->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text OR p.atomic_receipt->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_number::text
  OR a.stack_result->'success' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb OR a.stack_result->'conservation_checked' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR a.post_commit_completed_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(a.post_commit_completed_at) OR a.post_commit_result->'ok' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
  OR p.stack_claim->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded' OR p.stack_claim->'result' IS DISTINCT FROM a.stack_result
  OR p.stack_settlement->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final'
  OR p.stack_claim->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text
  OR p.stack_claim->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a.stack_result->>'hand_id'
  OR p.stack_settlement->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a.stack_result->>'hand_id'
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM settlement_idempotency_keys k WHERE k.table_id=p_table AND k.hand_id=(a.stack_result->>'hand_id')::uuid
    AND k.status='succeeded' AND smarter_private.horse_settlement_original_result(k.table_id,k.hand_id,k.result)=a.stack_result)
  OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_settlements c WHERE c.table_id=p_table AND c.hand_id=(a.stack_result->>'hand_id')::uuid
    AND c.state='final' AND c.totals=p.stack_settlement->'totals') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_atomic_completion_required';END IF;
 submitted:=a.post_commit_payload-'accepted_hand_facts';
 IF jsonb_typeof(a.post_commit_payload) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR a.post_commit_payload->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'
  OR jsonb_typeof(a.post_commit_payload->'accepted_hand_facts') IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
  OR jsonb_typeof(a.post_commit_payload#>'{pending_addons,ids}') IS DISTINCT FROM 'array'
  OR encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.post_commit_payload::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM a.post_commit_payload_hash
  OR a.post_commit_result->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM a.hand_id::text
  OR a.post_commit_result->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM a.hand_number::text
  OR a.committed_at IS NULL OR NOT isfinite(a.committed_at) OR a.post_commit_completed_at<a.committed_at THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_postcommit_seal_disagrees';END IF;
 submitted:=submitted#-'{pending_addons,ids}';
 IF encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(submitted::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex') IS DISTINCT FROM a.post_commit_request_hash THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_postcommit_request_disagrees';END IF;

  completed_at:=a.post_commit_completed_at;pending_ids:=a.post_commit_payload#>'{pending_addons,ids}';
  IF retained AND (cert.original->>'postcommit_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a.post_commit_payload_hash
   OR cert.original->>'postcommit_request_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM a.post_commit_request_hash
   OR cert.original->>'postcommit_result_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM encode(extensions.digest(convert_to(a.post_commit_result::text,'UTF8'),'sha256'),'hex')
   OR (cert.original->>'committed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.committed_at
   OR (cert.original->>'completed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM a.post_commit_completed_at
   OR cert.original->'pending_ids' IS DISTINCT FROM pending_ids) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:retained_postcommit_certificate_conflicts_with_original_live';END IF;
 ELSE
  IF NOT retained OR p.atomic_receipt->>'table_id' IS DISTINCT FROM p_table::text
   OR p.atomic_receipt->>'hand_number' IS DISTINCT FROM p_number::text
   OR p.atomic_receipt->>'hand_id' IS DISTINCT FROM o.hand_id::text OR p.atomic_receipt->>'payload_hash' IS DISTINCT FROM o.payload_hash
   OR p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,success}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,conservation_checked}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'true'::jsonb
   OR p.stack_claim->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'succeeded' OR p.stack_claim->'result' IS DISTINCT FROM p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result'
   OR p.stack_settlement->>'state' IS DISTINCT FROM 'final'
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM settlement_idempotency_keys k WHERE k.table_id=p_table AND k.hand_id=(p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,hand_id}')::uuid
    AND k.status='succeeded' AND smarter_private.horse_settlement_original_result(k.table_id,k.hand_id,k.result)=p.atomic_receipt->'stack_result')
   OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ca_settlements c WHERE c.table_id=p_table AND c.hand_id=(p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,hand_id}')::uuid
    AND c.state='final' AND c.totals=p.stack_settlement->'totals') THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:retained_original_atomic_completion_required';END IF;
  IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM smarter_private.horse_settlement_key_certificates k WHERE k.table_id=p_table AND k.hand_number=p_number
   AND ((k.history_hand_id,k.manifest_id,k.stack_hand_id) IS DISTINCT FROM (o.hand_id,p.manifest_id,(p.atomic_receipt#>>'{stack_result,hand_id}')::uuid)
    OR k.original_result_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original->>'original_stack_result_sha256'
    OR k.original_request_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original->>'original_stack_request_sha256'
    OR k.accounting_evidence_sha256 IS DISTINCT FROM cert.original->>'qualified_evidence_sha256'
    OR k.settled_at IS DISTINCT FROM (cert.original->>'completed_at')::timestamptz)) THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_retention_key_certificate_disagrees';END IF;
  completed_at:=(cert.original->>'completed_at')::timestamptz;pending_ids:=cert.original->'pending_ids';
 END IF;
 IF jsonb_typeof(p.participants) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants) NOT BETWEEN 2 AND 10
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants)<>jsonb_array_length(m.participants)
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants)<>jsonb_array_length(o.evidence->'participants')
  OR jsonb_array_length(p.participants)<>jsonb_array_length(p.accepted_request->'stacks')
  OR (SELECT count(DISTINCT x->>'user_id') FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants) x)<>jsonb_array_length(p.participants) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:full_original_roster_required';END IF;
 FOR part IN SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.participants) x LOOP
  before_stack:=fn_pnl_evidence_cents(part->'stack_before');after_stack:=fn_pnl_evidence_cents(part->'stack_after');
  IF before_stack IS NULL OR after_stack IS NULL OR before_stack<0 OR after_stack<0
   OR jsonb_typeof(part->'is_horse') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean' OR part->>'user_id' IS NULL OR part->>'seat_id' IS NULL OR part->>'occupancy_id' IS NULL OR part->>'seat_joined_at' IS NULL THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:strict_original_stack_and_identity_required';END IF;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(m.participants) x WHERE x->>'user_id'=part->>'user_id'
    AND x->>'seat_id'=part->>'seat_id' AND x->>'occupancy_id'=part->>'occupancy_id'
    AND x->>'seat_joined_at'=part->>'seat_joined_at' AND x->'is_horse'=part->'is_horse' AND x->'stack_before'=part->'stack_before'
    AND x->'funding_lineage'=part->'funding_lineage')<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.accepted_request->'stacks') x WHERE x->>'user_id'=part->>'user_id'
    AND x->>'seat_id'=part->>'seat_id' AND x->>'occupancy_id'=part->>'occupancy_id'
    AND x->>'seat_joined_at'=part->>'seat_joined_at' AND fn_pnl_evidence_cents(x->'stack_before')=before_stack
    AND fn_pnl_evidence_cents(x->'stack')=after_stack)<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(p.atomic_receipt#>'{stack_result,request,stacks}') x WHERE x->>'user_id'=part->>'user_id'
    AND x->>'seat_id'=part->>'seat_id' AND x->>'seat_joined_at'=part->>'seat_joined_at'
    AND fn_pnl_evidence_cents(x->'stack_before')=before_stack AND fn_pnl_evidence_cents(x->'stack')=after_stack)<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:signed_original_player_disagrees';END IF;
  lin:=fn_cash_original_funding_lineage((part->>'user_id')::uuid,p_table,(part->>'seat_id')::uuid,(part->>'occupancy_id')::uuid,
   (part->>'seat_joined_at')::timestamptz,(part#>>'{funding_lineage,observed_at}')::timestamptz,false);
  IF lin->'issues' IS DISTINCT FROM '[]'::jsonb OR (lin-'issues') IS DISTINCT FROM ((part->'funding_lineage')-'issues')
   OR part#>'{funding_lineage,issues}' IS DISTINCT FROM (CASE WHEN part->>'user_id'=affected::text THEN '["pending_funding_application_unproven"]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END)
   OR jsonb_array_length(lin->'funding_receipts')=0 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_lineage_disagrees';END IF;
  owned:=NULL;refs:=ARRAY[]::uuid[];
  FOR ref IN SELECT x FROM jsonb_array_elements(lin->'funding_receipts') x LOOP
   SELECT * INTO STRICT f FROM cash_participant_funding_receipts WHERE id=(ref->>'id')::uuid;
   IF f.id=ANY(refs) OR f.user_id IS DISTINCT FROM (part->>'user_id')::uuid OR f.account_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'player_wallet'
    OR f.account_entity_id IS DISTINCT FROM f.user_id OR f.funding_club_id IS NULL OR (owned IS NOT NULL AND owned<>f.funding_club_id)
    OR f.funding_union_id::text IS DISTINCT FROM o.game_scope->>'game_union_id' OR f.asset IS DISTINCT FROM 'chips' OR f.unit_scale IS DISTINCT FROM 2
    OR f.amount IS NULL OR f.amount<=0 OR f.amount<>round(f.amount,2) OR f.amount::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
    OR f.balance_before-f.balance_after IS DISTINCT FROM f.amount THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_wallet_owner_or_debit_disagrees';END IF;
   owned:=f.funding_club_id;refs:=array_append(refs,f.id);
  END LOOP;
  IF (SELECT count(*) FROM cash_participant_funding_receipts WHERE id=ANY(refs) AND operation_kind='buyin')<>1
   OR (SELECT count(*) FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.evidence->'participants') x WHERE x->>'user_id'=part->>'user_id'
    AND x->'is_horse'=part->'is_horse' AND fn_pnl_evidence_cents(x->'observed_stack_delta')=after_stack-before_stack
    AND x->>'ownership_scope'='original_chip_funding_club'
    AND (SELECT array_agg(id ORDER BY id) FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(x->'funding_receipt_ids') t(id))=
        (SELECT array_agg(id::text ORDER BY id::text) FROM unnest(refs) t(id))
    AND CASE WHEN part->>'user_id'=affected::text THEN x->'ownership_certified'='false'::jsonb AND x->'earning_club_id'='null'::jsonb
      ELSE x->'ownership_certified'='true'::jsonb AND x->>'earning_club_id'=owned::text END)<>1 THEN
   RAISE EXCEPTION 'escrow_refused:original_earning_ownership_disagrees';END IF;
  total:=total+after_stack-before_stack;
  proof_people:=proof_people||jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('user_id',part->>'user_id','earning_club_id',owned,'funding_receipt_ids',refs,'poker_delta',after_stack-before_stack));
 END LOOP;
 IF p.signed_external_net IS DISTINCT FROM 0 OR fn_pnl_evidence_cents(p.accepted_request->'inflow') IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR p.rake IS NULL OR p.bbj IS NULL OR p.rake<0 OR p.bbj<0 OR total+p.rake+p.bbj IS DISTINCT FROM 0
  OR fn_pnl_evidence_cents(o.evidence->'accepted_rake') IS DISTINCT FROM p.rake
  OR fn_pnl_evidence_cents(o.evidence->'accepted_bbj') IS DISTINCT FROM p.bbj
  OR fn_pnl_evidence_cents(o.evidence->'accepted_external_net') IS DISTINCT FROM p.signed_external_net
  OR fn_pnl_evidence_cents(o.evidence->'observed_delta_total') IS DISTINCT FROM total
